# Rash

> Rash is a declarative local automation tool using Ansible-like YAML tasks and MiniJinja templates, distributed as a single Rust binary with no runtime dependencies.

Use the versioned documentation index for technical questions. The `latest` documentation is built from the unreleased `master` branch; released versions are available through the documentation version selector.

## Documentation

- [Development documentation index](https://rash-sh.github.io/docs/rash/latest/llms.txt): Machine-oriented navigation for the current `master` documentation.
- [Development documentation](https://rash-sh.github.io/docs/rash/latest/): Human-readable documentation for the current `master` branch.

## Project

- [Source repository](https://github.com/rash-sh/rash): Rash implementation, tests, examples, and documentation sources.
- [Releases](https://github.com/rash-sh/rash/releases): Published Rash releases and release notes.
